verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no adapters or integrations for Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI. The MCP server targets AI assistant clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf), and the Python/TypeScript SDKs and REST API are general building blocks, not documented framework adapters. These are adjacent capabilities that do not satisfy this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the browser layer into agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI) through documented adapters
